wholePhysicalScope: Named six-point L-plan hotel footprint, original National Park Service aerial and historic register description.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the L-plan hotel, red roofs, veranda and lean-to. Near levels add sash details, screen frames and trim.
limitations: The original aerial shows roof massing through the snow. The National Park Service and historic register document the red roof, two-storey L-plan frame, full south veranda and east lean-to.
Window and door spacing, roof joints, lean-to size, veranda screens and foundation levels are approximate. The model represents the 2005 post-restoration hotel exterior.
The original elevation field is preserved. Local rear ground rises to the north wing. Porch access and individual foundation heights reflect the approximate terrain datum.
